newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EIB lends 100 mln marks to Elbe tunnel scheme.
newsitem.headline: EIB lends 100 mln marks to Elbe tunnel scheme.

text.p: The European Investment Bank announced on Tuesday it was providing an initial long-term loan of 100 million marks to help fund construction of a fourth motorway tunnel beneath the Elbe river in Hamburg, Germany.

The 3.1-kilometre tunnel project will be funded through a banking consortium led by Deutsche Girozentrale - Deutsche Kommunalbank and including Bayerische Landesbank, Hamburgische Landesbank, Kreditanstalt fuer Wiederaufbau and Landesbank Berlin.

The City of Hamburg will coordinate the seven-year project and negotiate with the consortium of building contractors, ARGE, which has been given sole responsibility for planning, construction and financing.
ARGE comprises Dyckerhoff & Widmann AG, Bauunternehmung Heitkamp GmBH, Bilfinger + Berger Bau AG, Hochtief AG, Philipp Holzmann AG, Wayss & Freytag AG and Ed. Zueblin AG.
The European Investment Bank is the financing institution of the 15-member European Union.
